Commentary.Commentary: It was the seamers of the Lankans who took all the wickets. Vishwa Fernando ended with four while Kasun Rajitha and Lahiru Kumara ended with three wickets each. Overall, they bowled really well to rattle the hosts on the back foot. Sri Lanka lead by 92 runs. They will hope to end the session without losing any wickets. Join us for the third innings in a while.

That is a solid performance by Sri Lankan bowlers. They have an incredible job of restricting Bangladesh to such a total. Sri Lanka took three wickets at the end of Day 1 and were tight today as well. Lahiru Kumara was just brilliant as he bowled tight line and lengths to take three wickets in no time. Taijul Islam played well but got out on 47. The other batters chipped in bt none made a big impact.

...Day 2, Session 2...

LUNCH! A fantastic session for Sri Lanka and they continue to dominate the proceedings. Three wickets for them in this session. Their seamers continued from where they left off on Day 1 as they bowled in tight channels. Mahmudul Hasan Joy left the crease early. Hossain edged one to the slips. Litton Das and Taijul Islam then tried to rebuild and just when it seemed that this partnership is going to fly, Lahiru Kumara came up with a banger. He was the pick as all three wickets went to him in this session. Bangladesh have a big task as they trail by 148 runs. Taijul Islam is batting well but need some help from the other end. Can Mehidy Hasan do the task or Sri Lanka will dominate the second session? We will find out after the break.

It’s time for Day 2 between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. After an eventful Day 1, we can fairly say the visitors are slightly in command thanks to the 200-plus partnership between de Silva and Kamindu. Also, the three wickets they took in the last hour or so. Bangladesh have a lot of work to do. They have to first see out the early swing from the Lankan seamers and make sure they are the one who start Day 2 brightly by building a formidable partnership. Can they do so? Let’s find out.
...Day 2, Session 1...

Sri Lanka bossed the second session but both fell after getting their centuries. It was the debutant who broke the deadlock. Nahid Rana went for runs but came back brilliantly in his second spell to get both the centurions in quick succession. Bangladesh made sure the tail did not wag much and took five wickets in the final session as well. However, in reply, they lost three wickets in an hour or so of play. They have lost few key batters but still have plenty of batting left. Bangladesh need to make sure to start Day 2 well while the ball is still now so Sri Lanka will hope for some early inroads. Join us at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT) and earlier for the build up. Till  then, cheers!

Stumps! A day that started well by Bangladesh but in the end, it's the visitors who will have a good sleep. Bangladesh opted to bowl first and were right on the money, taking five wickets in no time. Khaled Ahmed was the man of the hour and it looked like they will rattle the visitors quickly but then came the stubborn partnership which turned things around and got Sri Lanka back on track. Dhananjaya de Silva and Kamindu Mendis joined hands to add more than 200. Mendis was dropped in the slips on the first ball and went onto make a hundred while the skipper under a lot pressure played a brilliant innings as well.
That will be Stumps! Full and on middle, Joy flicks it to mid-wicket.
